question: ttft
answer:
- **Time to first token (TTFT).** `stream_chat()` starts `time.perf_counter()` just before opening the streaming HTTP request. It records elapsed time when `_delta_text()` first extracts non-empty answer text or reasoning from a streamed delta. It also tracks first visible content and first exposed reasoning separately. [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py#L97)
- **Tokens per second.** `ChatResult.decode_tps` divides the provider-reported completion token count by the elapsed time between the first and last deltas carrying text or reasoning. It skips short generations and very small timing windows. `ChatResult.e2e_tps` divides the same count by the successful attempt’s full wall time through stream closure, including TTFT and any trailing usage chunk. [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py#L74)
- **Reporting.** `_record()` stores both rates. `summarize()` uses `_median()` to report TTFT across successful measured runs and both throughput rates across successful runs of the designated throughput prompt. Warmups are excluded. [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py](src/nvidia_ai/bench.py#L205)
